strings.seo.why[3].text: PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, OpenDocument, jamuqanaka, EPUB… computadorat jan ukax fonot.
strings.seo.faq[0].a: Arisa. Taqi lurañanakax inakiwa, mana marqani ukat qollqëwinakampix jan jark’ata. Mana tarjeta de crédito mañaskiti.
strings.seo.faq[1].a: Janiwa. Mana qellqasisiñani, mana correo electrónico: jank’akiw lurañanaka apnaqtata.
strings.seo.faq[2].a: Janiwa. Qillqatanakama lurañatakikipuniw apnaqasi, ukatx chhaqhystata. Janiw khitis uñjkiti jan ukax khithaskiti.
strings.seo.faq[3].a: Arisa. pdff ukax kawkïri fono, tablet jan ukax computadoran navegadoranw sarantxi (Android, iPhone, Windows, Mac, Linux), mana imantañampikiti.
strings.seo.faq[4].a: PDF, Word (DOCX, DOC), Excel (XLSX, XLS, CSV), PowerPoint (PPTX, PPT), OpenDocument (ODT, ODS, ODP), RTF, jamuqanaka (JPG, PNG, WebP, AVIF, TIFF, GIF, SVG), EPUB, TXT, HTML ukat yaqhanaka.
strings.seo.faq[5].a: {files} qillqatanakakipuniw sapa mayni warkusisi, ukat lurt’at qillqatax {pages} qillqatanakaniw lurasisi.
strings.privacy.title: Imantata
strings.privacy.description: Kunjamasa pdff qillqatanakamar uñjasi: mana qillqasisiñani, mana qillqata imantata, mana anunciunaka ukat mana yatiyatanaka aljañampikiti.
strings.privacy.intro: pdff ukax lurt’atawa qillqatanakamax qhipaqañapataki. Aka qillqatan uñacht’ayasi kunjamsa apnaqasi.
strings.privacy.sections[0].title: Qillqatanakama
strings.privacy.sections[0].text: Khitatawa (HTTPS), kikpaki lurt’ata, ukhamaraki lurt’atasti jank’akiw chhaqhystata. Jach’a qillqatanakax 24 horaspachanw chhaqhyasi.
strings.privacy.sections[1].title: Mana qillqasiñani, mana qillqata yatiyata
strings.privacy.sections[1].text: pdff janiw qellqasisiñani, correo electrónico jan ukax tarjeta de crédito mañaskiti. Janiw khitis uñjkiti jan ukax inteligencia artificial lurañatakix apnaqkiti.
strings.privacy.sections[2].title: Uñjatanaka uñjaña
strings.privacy.sections[2].text: Uñjatanakax mayni mayniw jikxatasi (Vercel Web Analytics) kawkïri lurañanakas wali askïchix uñjañataki. Mana anunciunaka utjkiti.
strings.privacy.sections[3].title: Galleta (Cookies)
strings.privacy.sections[3].text: Mä galleta ukakipuniwa: ajllita arumpi amtasiri.
strings.privacy.sections[4].title: Servidor ukaru churaña
strings.privacy.sections[4].text: Aka web utax Vercel ukampiw Paris markan uñstayasi; Word, Excel ukat PowerPoint lurañanakax Frankfurt markan Render ukampiw lurasisi.
